race.title: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap
race.verdict: James Owen looked to be finding the key to MERITOCRATIC before he was sent hurdling minus headgear and he's tentatively selected to shed his maiden status back on all-weather. Far Far Out is a solid rival, with Herstmonceux and Intsaar potential improvers. MERITOCRATIC (IRE) FAR FAR OUT (IRE) HERSTMONCEUX
race.bettingForecast: Far Far Out (9/4), Meritocratic (5/2), A Daughters Love (6/1), Turton (8/1), Intsaar (8/1), Akrivos (12/1), Bennyworth (16/1), Venturing (16/1), Herstmonceux (20/1), Parole Board (33/1), Karmacy (50/1), Emerald Reine (66/1), Baggie Boy (66/1), Glamerous (66/1)
